title: Structure tagging extension (visits, GPS, classification, status)
summary: Added migration_047 and full web/API support for structure tagging fields: location, visit rounds, Primary/Secondary/Associated classification with primary-structure search, GPS, tagging status with conditional other/refusal text.

items: New columns on structures for tagging workflow; optional FK associated_primary_structure_id → structures(id)
Classification/status option helpers, expandTaggingPayload, searchPrimaryStructures, find() join for associated primary tag
create/update/createWithStrid persist tagging columns
Form and read-only display for all tagging fields; PDF rows aligned
mergeStructureTaggingFromRequest on web store/update and API store/update
GET /api/structure/primary-search
getApi exposes new fields
Toggle associated primary Select2, other specify, refusal reason; primary-search ajax
Documented fields, route, migration 047

changes.area: App/ListConfig.php + App/Models/Structure.php listPaginated + App/Views/structure/index.php + CsvExporter + PdfTable
items: Structure list Status column (tagging_status), sort/search, labeled export cells
Edit form Back link targets /structure/view/{id}; create still Back to /structure
mergeStructureTaggingFromRequest is protected so Api StructureController can merge POST fields (fixes profile modal POST /api/structure/store)
structure-list-paps-data.spec passes explicit columns= so search includes structure_tag when user column prefs omit it
List PDF uses GET per_page (10–500, default 250) instead of always 2500 rows; avoids mPDF OOM on large installs; aligns with list_toolbar PDF URL
profile-age-minimum: .alert-danger:not(.d-none)
profile-soft-delete: list name Last, First
profile-export-pdf: PDF bytes + content-type with per_page=15
profile-edit + profile-ownership-fields: waitForResponse without resp.ok() so failed API calls fail fast
profile-ownership-fields edit test: ensure contact + barangay selectOption so client validation runs Save main
Structure view GPS latitude/longitude become clickable Google Maps links when both coordinates exist
Added tagging status option exceeded_number_of_visits (label: Exceeded number of Visits)
